topic.name: 旋转蜂鸣器与行进队列
topic.title: 声源没改音调，听到的频率为什么会变？
topic.question: 声源没改音调，听到的频率为什么会变？
topic.description: 用竹竿端蜂鸣器的旋转与路旁观察者的行走，分别追踪声源运动和接收者运动改变波峰到达频率的过程。
topic.tag: 每次到达都来自一次发出

zh: 旋转蜂鸣器与行进队列

translations.声源没改音调，听到的频率为什么会变？: Why does received pitch change when the source tone stays the same?
translations.用竹竿端蜂鸣器的旋转与路旁观察者的行走，分别追踪声源运动和接收者运动改变波峰到达: Follow a rotating rod-end buzzer and a walking observer beside a queue to compare source motion with receiver motion.
translations.每次到达都来自一次发出: Every arrival traces back to an emission
translations.举过头顶旋转的竹竿、杆端蜂鸣器、固定听者与波峰到达记录: An overhead rotating bamboo rod, a battery-powered buzzer, a fixed listener and crest-arrival records
translations.匀速行进的人群与静止、逆行或同向行走的观察者: An evenly marching queue with a stationary, opposing or following observer
translations.试听当前接收音调: Listen to the current received pitch
translations.声音不可用，波峰与频率读数仍可观察。: Audio is unavailable; crests and frequency remain visible.
translations.圆形线是三维声波波面的水平截面，每个圆心保留在发出位置。空气静止，声速340米每: Circles are horizontal slices of spherical sound fronts, centred at their emission positions. Air is still, sound speed is 340 m/s, and the listener is 5 m from the pivot. Received frequency uses radial source velocity at the retarded emission time. Motion is slowed; the two tick rows compare the same consecutive crests, with their first ticks aligned separately. Optional audio synthesizes the current received frequency. Queue members represent crests only, spaced 2 m apart and moving at 1 m/s. Counting excludes the person aligned at the initial instant. A following observer always moves slower than the queue.
translations.声源和听者静止，收到的频率与发声频率相同。: A stationary source and listener give the same emitted and received frequency.
translations.杆端靠近和远离听者，接收频率交替升高和降低。: As the rod end approaches and recedes, received frequency rises and falls.
translations.发出间隔相同，到达间隔随传播路程改变。: Equal emission intervals become different arrival intervals as paths change.
translations.每人间隔2米、每秒前进1米：每分钟经过30人。: At 2 m spacing and 1 m/s, thirty people pass each minute.
translations.间隔和队速未变，观察者每分钟遇到45人。: Spacing and queue speed stay fixed, but forty-five people are met per minute.
translations.顺着队伍走，但走得更慢: Follow more slowly than the queue
translations.观察者每分钟只遇到15人，接收频率降低。: Only fifteen people are met per minute, representing a lower received frequency.

cues.title: 固定蜂鸣器，建立基准
cues.caption: 声源和听者静止，收到的频率与发声频率相同。
cues.captionEn: A stationary source and listener give the same emitted and received frequency.
cues.zh: 竹竿端固定着电池和蜂鸣器，听者站在转轴外五米处。先让竹竿保持不动。每一个波面都从同一个位置发出，相邻波峰等间隔到达。这里发声频率设为六百赫兹，接收频率也是六百赫兹。画面已经放慢，便于观察波峰。
cues.en: A battery powers the buzzer at the end of a bamboo rod. The listener stands five metres from the pivot. First hold the rod still. Each wavefront leaves the same position, and successive crests arrive at equal intervals. Both emitted and received frequencies are six hundred hertz. Motion is slowed so the crests can be followed.

cues.title: 把蜂鸣器举过头顶旋转
cues.caption: 杆端靠近和远离听者，接收频率交替升高和降低。
cues.captionEn: As the rod end approaches and recedes, received frequency rises and falls.
cues.zh: 现在转动竹竿，蜂鸣器自身仍然每秒振动六百次。留意每个声波圆心，它停留在当初发出的位置，不会被竹竿拖着走。声源向听者靠近时，波峰到达得更密；远离时更疏。改变的是听者接收到的频率。
cues.en: Rotate the rod while the buzzer continues to oscillate six hundred times each second. Each circular front keeps its own emission centre; the rod does not drag an old front around. Approaching motion brings arrivals closer together, while receding motion spreads them apart. The changing quantity is the frequency received by the listener.

cues.title: 比较同一批波峰的到达记录
cues.caption: 发出间隔相同，到达间隔随传播路程改变。
cues.captionEn: Equal emission intervals become different arrival intervals as paths change.
cues.zh: 把同一批连续波峰排成两行刻度，并各自对齐第一条刻度。发出的时间间隔始终相等，到达的一行却会压缩或展开。声音需要传播时间，所以收到这一刻的频率，取决于那一声发出时蜂鸣器的运动，而不是画面此刻的位置。
cues.en: Compare two rows for the same consecutive crests, aligning the first tick in each row separately. Emission intervals stay equal, while arrival intervals contract or expand. Sound takes time to travel. The frequency heard now therefore depends on the buzzer’s motion when that sound was emitted, rather than its current displayed position.

cues.title: 站在队列旁数经过的人
cues.caption: 每人间隔2米、每秒前进1米：每分钟经过30人。
cues.captionEn: At 2 m spacing and 1 m/s, thirty people pass each minute.
cues.zh: 再换一种教材模拟。队伍匀速行走，相邻两人间隔两米，速度每秒一米。观察者站着不动，每两秒就有一人经过，对应每分钟三十人。这里的人代表向前传播的波峰，不能把他们当成原地振动的介质质点。
cues.en: Now use the textbook’s queue analogy. People march at one metre per second with two metres between neighbours. A stationary observer encounters one person every two seconds, or thirty per minute. In this analogy people stand for travelling wave crests. They do not represent material particles oscillating around fixed positions.

cues.title: 观察者逆着队伍走
cues.caption: 间隔和队速未变，观察者每分钟遇到45人。
cues.captionEn: Spacing and queue speed stay fixed, but forty-five people are met per minute.
cues.zh: 让观察者以每秒半米逆着队伍走。队伍本身没有加速，人员间隔也没有改变；只是观察者和迎面的人更快相遇。相遇间隔缩短到三分之四秒，折合每分钟四十五人。虚线标出观察者当时的位置，计数来自真实经过它的人。
cues.en: Let the observer walk against the queue at half a metre per second. Neither marching speed nor spacing changes. The observer simply meets the approaching people sooner. Encounters are four-thirds of a second apart, giving forty-five per minute. The dashed line follows the observer, and the counter records people actually crossing that position.

cues.title: 顺着队伍走，但走得更慢
cues.titleEn: Follow more slowly than the queue
cues.caption: 观察者每分钟只遇到15人，接收频率降低。
cues.captionEn: Only fifteen people are met per minute, representing a lower received frequency.
cues.zh: 最后让观察者以每秒半米顺着队伍走，仍然慢于队伍。身后的人需要更长时间才能追到他，四秒才有一人经过，折合每分钟十五人。三个比较保留同一队伍和同样间隔，只改变观察者速度，就改变了单位时间接收的波峰数。
cues.en: Finally the observer walks with the queue at half a metre per second, still slower than the marchers. People behind take longer to catch up. One passes every four seconds, or fifteen per minute. All three comparisons preserve the same queue and spacing. Changing only observer velocity changes the number of crests received per unit time.
